paper_facing_name: Hierarchical Move-Blocked Mixed-Integer MPC with Causal Domain Reduction

decisions: queued-job start block, rack, and IDC placement
slow_master.circle_role: polyhedral lower-bound/screening model; never a physical commit authority
slow_master.exact_forced_domain_rule: Skip the MILP only when every retained slow decision has exactly one feasible option

fast_recourse.charge_discharge_exclusivity_recovery: If the relaxed convex-QCP incumbent exceeds the frozen 1e-4 kW simultaneous charge/discharge gate, fix every five-minute dispatch direction from incumbent net power and re-solve all lexicographic priorities inside the original watchdog; never widen the gate or commit the relaxed incumbent.
exact_constraints: fixed slow-decision GPU, rack, IDC, WAN, checkpoint, and deadline feasibility
fast_recourse.acceptance: Exact QCP residual at frozen numerical tolerance and no simultaneous charge/discharge

lexicographic_objectives: min sum_h z_h * delta_t subject to priority 1
min secondary actuation subject to priorities 1 and 2
unchanged_scientific_semantics: voltage, line, transformer, SOC, PCS, mobility, GPU, rack, IDC, WAN, checkpoint, deadline, and recovery constraints
Fresh exact three-phase OpenDSS commit gate
online_commit_chain: bounded 9-stage slow MILP master or exact forced-domain skip
fixed-slow-decision exact H54 continuous QCP recourse

watchdog.production_freeze_rule: After January development, set the production watchdog from the measured steady-state p99 plus a documented margin; do not use the runtime performance target itself as the timeout
watchdog.semantics: Fail closed on timeout; never relax an objective priority or hard constraint

runtime_acceptance.comparison_scope: Same issue, state, forecast, candidate K, Gurobi thread count, objective, hard constraints, Fresh OpenDSS gate, and storage path
runtime_acceptance.measured_quantity: End-to-end total issue wall time, with component timings retained
runtime_acceptance.rule: A computational alternative with no paired speed improvement is removed from the production path

approved_solver_runtime_settings.numeric_focus_evidence: Paired 19-step B06 validation reduced steady end-to-end median and p95 with identical route decisions, predicted objectives, Fresh-AC values, zero exact residual, and AC PASS.
